## Summary

**Definition-level flow policies evaluate beside capability contracts —
one evaluator, the spec's tier order.** `hh_provenance::flow_policy`
lands `FlowPolicy{policy_id, issuer, scope, rules}` — the
`HarnessRule{action: flow_policy}` payload shape §5g.2 §3 owns — with
`validate_flow_policy` (issuer ≥ definition; grammar-closed, bounded,
non-recursive, non-code-bearing; the codec fails closed) and
`check_flow_policy` delegating to the same `check_flow` evaluator the
contract rules use. `Monitor.flow_policies` rides `AuthorizeInput`
byte-identically out-of-process; contract rules and definition rules
combine before evaluation so the deny tier still fires first
(ADR-0288 D1/D2; `flow_policies_evaluate_alongside_contract_rules`).

**The policy-edit classifier is exact over a declared finite space.**
`classify_policy_edit(P, P′, ProposalSpace)` enumerates every declared
`PolicyPoint` (domain, world, capability, canonical args, per-param
labels, recipients, `L⁺`, committed projection, detector verdicts) and
compares allowed sets — `narrowing ⇔ allowed(P′) ⊆ allowed(P)`,
`widening` pure strict superset, `incomparable` mixed (ADR-0056 D5's
decidable encoding). `apply_policy_edit` gates on the proposer's
`Origin`: `evolution` refuses any non-narrowing edit; other
delegate-class origins refuse `widening`/`incomparable`
(`WideningRequiresHuman`); human/kernel/definition apply any class.
`incomparable` counts as widening for `authority_delta` (ADR-0017;
`ac_h2_9_classifier_is_exact_and_origin_gated`).

**`_meta["hir/provenance"]` lowers and lifts with authority fixed by
source — never by payload.** `lower_provenance_meta` emits
`{origin_ref, authority, scope, taint_tags[], readers[]}` (`readers: []
= Public`) in the typed extension slot; `lift_provenance_meta` mints
`unverified` for an external server, `external` for a declared
open-world tool, `unverified` for an unvouched participant — the
payload's own `authority` string is never consulted — and returns the
explicit carried/lost report (a target that cannot carry the member is
named; `role_map_collapse` reports the class distinctions a
reduced-role map cannot express) (ADR-0288 D3;
`ac_h2_13_and_ac_r_2_1_5_7_meta_round_trip`).

**The endorsement emitters enforce their bounds.** `shape_endorse`
produces `security.label.endorsed{capacity_bits ≤ cap_max,
robustness_inputs[]}` under the validator basis; `sanitize_endorse`
produces the `policy_rule (b)` record under `SanitizerBounds` —
`check_sanitizer_effect` refuses a sanitizer that grants authority,
drops taint beyond the declared `removes`, or escapes `bounds.to`'s
reader set (`ac_h2_7_sanitizer_bound_exceeded_and_compliant_endorsement`).

**The consumed remedy is on the decided record.** `Proposal.remedy_taken`
propagates to `KernelDecision.remedy_taken` and the
`security.permission.decided` payload — absent-not-null when `None`
(CC8); the wire codec round-trips it, the OOP `AuthorizeInput` carries
it, `hh-env::dispatch` stamps `None` (I-F6 R3;
`remedy_taken_wire_round_trip`). `LedgerFacts` folds
`remedies.offered`/`taken` + `approvals.requested`/`consumed` off the
decided rows; `taint_precision` is the advisory `|denied ∩
judged-influenced| / |denied ∩ judged|` — declared as a
`Validator{kind: judge}`-class metric, **reported, never enforced**
(I-F1; `ac_h2_11_taint_precision_reported_never_enforced`).

**The battery.** `crates/hh-monitor/tests/s3_11a.rs` (22 tests):
AT-H1-01 (injection fixture → never allow; approval binds one
`effect_id`), AT-H1-03 (M-CPE/X-CPE escalated contexts +
`ScopeCeilingExceeded`), AT-H1-05 (evolution is delegate-class
everywhere), AT-H1-06 (no `committed` without `decided{allow}`),
AT-H1-07 (`replay` matched over every decision class), AT-H1-08
(unattended `approvals = 0` ⇒ `ask → deny{UnattendedAsk}`),
AT-H1-09 (kernel assessment raise-only), AT-H1-12 (lease/approval exact
binding), AT-H1-13 (judge `allow` never resolves), AT-H1-14 (table
rebuild byte-equal), AT-H1-15 (Π default/narrowed/off arms → matched
`ComparisonReport`), AC-H2-4 (prospective label binds), AC-H2-7
(sanitizer bounds), AC-H2-8 (corpus round-trip + totality + p99),
AC-H2-9 (classifier ↔ exhaustive enumeration + origin gating),
AC-H2-10 (taint-gate recipe → default class `deny`), AC-H2-11
(`taint_precision` reported), AC-H2-13 + AC-R-2.1.5-7 (`_meta`
round-trip + loss report), AC-R-2.1.5-10 (matched-budget utility),
AC-R-2.1.5-11 (hosted `n/a{observability}` + class gating).
